newsitem.title: USA: Patriot, Doubletree to buy 3 hotels.
newsitem.headline: Patriot, Doubletree to buy 3 hotels.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc and Doubletree Corp said on Tuesday they had contracts to acquire three full-service hotels in Tallahassee and Miami, Fla. and in Chicago for a total of about $32 million.
Patriot American, which allied with Doubletree in August, will invest $28.8 million and Doubletree will invest $3.2 million, the companies said. The properties have a total of 750 rooms, they said.

Patriot and Doubletree said in August Patriot would invest $200 million in the next 24 months in hotel acquisitions sourced by Doubletree. In each deal, Doubletree would invest 10 percent, and lease and manage the properties.
These acquisitions were expected to close by the end of September and would bring the number of jointly owned hotels to four.
